description: This Java source file defines a custom ArrayAdapter for populating a ListView with ListItemObject instances. It manages stable IDs for list items, supports adding new items while maintaining ID consistency, and provides a utility method for creating circular cropped bitmaps for display in list items.

classes.name: CustomArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that handles ListItemObject items, maintaining stable IDs, and generating circular cropped images for display.

methods.name: CustomArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, layout resource, and data list, and setting up stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the given position.

methods.name: updateStableIds
methods.description: Resets and regenerates stable IDs for all data items.

methods.name: addStableIdForDataAtPosition
methods.description: Assigns a new stable ID to the data item at the specified position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter provides stable IDs.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for the list item at the specified position, setting image and text views appropriately.
